schema_note: v2 (10-13): judged on the pair equation with insertion-compensated clock entry; v1 judged each side against 0.2 T

rule.reading: die clock at tile X clock pin = phi - R_X (R = mean boundary-register insertion, the sign-off reference); hop A -> B: o_A + w L + s_B <= T - U - SKEW with o = clk->pin - R, s = setup@pin + R; per tile C = o + s, reach = (T - U - SKEW - C) / w; the sign-off SDC (0.2 T outside) only proves o, s <= signoff_allow each

die_clock.rule: clock at tile X clock pin = phi - R_X (+ common trunk); the branch to X carries R_max - R_X of added delay

ocv_skew_ps.note: every clock pin is matched to the deepest tile, so each side of every hop carries >= R_max of non-shared insertion: 2 x OCV x R_max of the die skew budget is spent before the die tree itself

ff_tt_tracking.note: R_ff / R_tt per tile; a fixed-ratio delay line misses the span by this much at the other corner
